instruction: Using only the standalone learner-facing English stem, prompts, and opaque token pools, select exactly one condition, two actions, and two parameters. Return the required structured JSON, including exactly one premise row for every opaque token. Do not infer absent client-specific facts.
stem: A 24-year-old client with asthma presents to a clinic with rapidly worsening breathlessness. The client speaks only one or two words at a time, sits hunched forward, uses accessory muscles, and has a respiratory rate of 34/min, heart rate of 128/min, SpO₂ 88% on room air, and PEF 42% of personal best. The client is alert, with no urticaria, facial swelling, stridor, or choking event. Emergency transfer is available, and the clinic's acute-asthma protocol and medication orders are active. Complete the bow-tie by choosing the condition, 2 actions, and 2 parameters to monitor.

actions.label: A1
actions.text: Continue routine outpatient treatment and schedule follow-up next week

actions.label: A2
actions.text: Arrange immediate transfer to an acute-care facility

actions.label: A3
actions.text: Administer a sedative to reduce respiratory distress

actions.label: A4
actions.text: Give protocol-directed inhaled SABA plus ipratropium, controlled oxygen, and the ordered systemic corticosteroid

parameters.label: P1
parameters.text: Symptoms and PEF or lung-function response at 1 hour or earlier

parameters.label: P2
parameters.text: Routine chest radiograph and arterial blood gas results

parameters.label: P4
parameters.text: SpO₂, respiratory rate, accessory-muscle use, and mental status
